findings.description: The function computes `cleaned` but returns `s == s[::-1]`, using the original string instead of the cleaned/reversed comparison. This makes it return incorrect results for inputs with spaces or mixed case, e.g., is_palindrome("A man a plan a canal Panama") returns False. Should be `return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]`.

The variable `cleaned` is unused except for assignment, which can confuse readers and indicates the bug. Also, only spaces are removed, not other whitespace or punctuation, so the function may not meet general palindrome expectations. Consider using `s.lower()` with filtering of non-alphanumeric characters if that is intended.
